_comment: Which golden transcript belongs to which page IMAGE.
This file exists because the golden set was silently misaligned: the
transcripts for images 08/09/10 were filed as page-07/08/09, and images
07 and 11 never had a matching transcript. Every benchmark number computed
before 2026-10-14 against pages 07-11 was therefore wrong, including the
figures in docs/ocr-engine-decision.md. The misalignment was found by
cross-correlating a competent transcription against every golden file
Bench scripts must resolve goldens through this map, never by filename.

alignment_proven_by.method: gemini-3.1-flash-lite transcription of every image scored against every golden

images_without_golden.page-07: no transcript matched this image (best cross-CER 79.0%)
images_without_golden.page-11: no transcript matched this image (best cross-CER 75.6%)

unmatched_transcripts._orphans/prev-page-10.txt: transcript for an image not present in data/samples/pages
unmatched_transcripts._orphans/prev-page-11.txt: transcript for an image not present in data/samples/pages

held_out.note: see data/samples/holdout.json - page-11 is listed there but has no golden; fix before using
